Avoid hearing the music twice

Your music app keeps playing on this phone right away, but everyone else hears it about 1 second later. Android does not let SyncSpeaker mute the original app.

• Easiest: turn on “Play on this phone too” and turn down the original sound (lower the volume in the music app if it has a slider, or put this phone away from the group).
• Best (if the Capture test shows that capture ignores the volume on your phone): set the media volume to 0, turn on “Play on this phone too” and “Use the alarm volume”, then use the alarm volume as this phone's volume.
• Or just let this phone be the DJ deck and keep its volume at 0.

Find out if an app's audio can be captured:

1. Tap “Start test” and allow sharing (choose “Entire screen” if asked).
2. Open Spotify (or any app) and play a song.
3. Come back here. If the meter moves, SyncSpeaker can stream that app.
